verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a banking-as-a-service platform, since vendors in this space sometimes offer on-prem or bank-deployed options, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes a hosted API: a Developer Sandbox account, API keys and endpoints. Nothing indicates a self-hostable or on-prem deployment. The "integrate with your existing stack" marketing line is about integration, not self-hosting.
